decisionsTitle: «The day the row was written» is the day its answers were written: a restart moves it, `created_at` stays (amending §323, §645)
decisionsSection:
**Why.** §645's review left one follow-up outside its branch (§645 «Follow-up»): «the day the row was written» was read as `created_at`, but a restart of a cancelled or expired registration (`AGENTS.md` §10.5) writes every answer again on its own instant — the guardian kept only for a minor on that day, no socials for one (§108, §323) — and keeps `created_at`. Two rules asked the old instant: the minors' sweep (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `minor-socials`, §323) and the staff correction's guardian and socials rules (§645, `answers.ts#planAnswerEdit`). So a row created while the person was seventeen and restarted after the eighteenth birthday — an adult's row by the form's own judgement, no guardian kept, the socials kept — had its socials cleared by the next maintenance run on a wrong premise, the correction refused it socials with `MINOR_AT_REGISTRATION`, and a birth date corrected by a day was refused for a guardian the restart had rightly not kept (§645's case B on a row it never applied to). The owner approved the fix as a small batch on 2026-10-03.

**Decision.** One column, `registrations.answers_written_at` (timestamptz, NOT NULL, default `now()`; migration `0127_answers_written_at`, expand only): the instant the form last wrote the person's answers. Written by the insert (`repository.ts#insertPendingEmailRegistration`, the same instant as `created_at`), by both restart paths (`service.ts#submitRegistration`, in `carriedFields`, so the unverified restart's transition and the verified restart's update both carry it), and by the family sitting's in-place correction of a form not yet confirmed (§543), which also judges the answers again on its own instant. A staff correction (§645) does not move it: it judges against it. **The backfill** sets it to `created_at` on every existing row — what the rules read until now, so no existing row is judged differently; a restart that happened before the column cannot be recovered from the row and stays judged on its creation. **The default** is evaluated at each insert, so a row the previous release inserts between the migration and the deploy is dated by its own insert, the same instant as its `created_at`; no reader needs a fallback. **Three readers moved:** the minors' sweep (`answers_written_at` in its condition), the correction's guardian and socials rules (`planAnswerEdit`'s context field is now `answersWrittenAt`, read from the row), and the registration page's guardian box (`guardianOpen`, and `GuardianForMinor`'s `minorOn`), all reading the same column, so the page and the server ask the same day.

**Unchanged, on purpose.** `created_at` keeps its meaning — when the row was first made — and every other reader of it (the lists' order, the timeline, the retention ages, the exports). The public form's rule of today (§108, §323) is the same; the column only records which day it was applied. The queue's order (`submitted_at`, `privacy_acknowledged_at`) is untouched.

**Refused.** Redefining `created_at` as the restart's instant: it is the row's birth, read by the lists, the trail and the retention ages, and a restart rewriting it would reorder the backoffice and age data wrongly. Reading `submitted_at`: a restart does not rewrite it either (§377), and it means the queue's first form. A nullable column with a fallback to `created_at` in every reader: once the backfill has run, no row lacks the value, and the default covers an insert that does not name it, so the fallback would only be a second way to say the same thing in four places. The one cost is test fixtures that set a past `created_at` alone: their answers are dated by the test's clock, so a fixture that is judged on the day it was written names `answers_written_at` too.

**Tests.** Integration `db/answers-written-at-migration.test.ts` (built up to `0126_hidden_list`, three registrations written without the column, the rest migrated over them: each ends with `answers_written_at = created_at`, the migration adds that one column NOT NULL with `now()` as its default, a row inserted afterwards the way the previous release inserts it — naming its own `created_at` a few seconds earlier, not the column — is dated by its own insert, not by that `created_at`, and the file drops and renames nothing); `registrations/answers-written-at.test.ts` (a first submission writes it beside `created_at`; a verified participant's restart after the eighteenth birthday moves it and keeps `created_at`, no guardian kept, the socials kept, the minors' sweep keeps them and a birth date corrected by a day owes no guardian and clears none of the socials; an unverified participant's restart of an expired row moves it too); `registrations/family-sitting.test.ts` (the §543 in-place correction moves it to the correction's instant and keeps `created_at`); `jobs/retention.test.ts` (a restarted row is judged on its answers' instant, a row not restarted on its creation); `registrations/answer-corrections.test.ts` (its fixtures written on a past day name that day for their answers too); `registrations/member-tick-screens.test.ts` (the page's guardian box on a row created at seventeen and restarted after the eighteenth birthday is closed, its `minorOn` the restart's instant; on a row created and written again while still seventeen it is open — the case fails when the page reads `created_at`); unit `registrations/answers.test.ts` (the plan's context reads the answers' instant).
changelogLine: - **A restarted registration is judged on the day it was restarted** — a row first written while the person was a minor and restarted as an adult no longer loses its Strava and Instagram at the next maintenance run, and «Modifică datele» no longer asks it for a parent or guardian; a new column records when the answers were written, backfilled from the creation date. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a cancelled or expired registration restarted through the public form, verified or not, when the restart completes, then `answers_written_at` is the restart's instant and `created_at` is unchanged; a first submission writes both on its own instant, the family sitting's correction of a form not yet confirmed (§543) moves it to the correction's instant, and every row written before the column carries its `created_at` (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amending criterion 5: «the day the row was written» is the day the registration's answers were written, `answers_written_at` — a restart's instant, not the row's creation. Given a registration created while the person was a minor and restarted after the eighteenth birthday, when the retention sweep runs, then its Strava link, Instagram username and list tick are kept; a row whose answers were written while the person was under eighteen is cleared as before (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 12 (amended): Given an Administrator on a registration's page, when they open «Datele înscrierii» (the read recorded as `registration.answers_viewed`) and save «Modifică datele», then only the answers that changed from the allowlist — the two names (the name of record following them, refused when another runner on the address carries it), the list name, birth date, sex, citizenship, country, city, phone, emergency contact, guardian, member tick and club, socials, T-shirt — are written, each through the form's own rule and cross-field rules, with one audit row `registration.answer_corrected` `{ field, from, to }` per column (and `registration.name_corrected` for the name of record), no state, place, number or email moved; the address, any consent, the declaration's statements and any non-answer key are refused by name, the guardian is refused once a declaration acceptance exists (the signed declaration still naming who signed) and a birth date that would then need one, or would make the signed minor's row an adult's, is refused on the birth date (`guardianSigned`, with `guardianAdult` for the latter), a guardian is owed and allowed on the one day the row was written — the day its answers were written, `answers_written_at` (a restart's instant, not the row's creation, so a row created while the person was a minor and restarted after the eighteenth birthday is an adult's row: a birth date corrected by a day owes no guardian and clears none of the socials) — on a row written while the person was a minor it cannot be cleared and is required when an adult's row is corrected to such a birth date, though the person is an adult today — a guardian on a row that was not a minor's when written is refused (`guardianAdult`) and a birth date corrected to an adult's before any declaration clears the guardian with its own audit row, the participant's own number as the emergency contact is refused with §231's `emergencySame` marker, a Strava link or username on a row written while the person was a minor is refused with `minorAtRegistration` (the minors' sweep's own test) — on the birth date when only the birth date moved — an empty or unchanged correction is refused, every other role is refused, the Organizer reads the answers with no form, the page's guardian box opens on that same day (`answers_written_at`, its `minorOn` too — closed on a minor's row restarted as an adult, open on one written again while still a minor), and the participant's own page shows the corrected values; the erase, the emergency contact's seven-day retention, and a withdrawal of the socials (by the person or by staff) or the minors' socials sweep remove the corrected values from the trail; verification: integration `registrations/answer-corrections.test.ts`, `registrations/answers-written-at.test.ts`, `registrations/member-tick.test.ts`, `registrations/member-tick-screens.test.ts` (the guardian box asks the day the answers were written, not the row's creation); unit `registrations/answers.test.ts` (`DECISIONS.md` §645; amended 2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a restart rewrites the day the answers were written
